reviewer_issues: DANIEL_OPT_07 and DANIEL_OPT_08 trigger on WALL_WHISPER_HEARD, which is not limited to the basement or to after DANIEL_IN_BASEMENT. Gate them to the basement after Daniel arrives, or give the whisper reaction to someone else outside the basement.

JEFF_S3_12 and JEFF_S3_13 place the Flighted poster at the outpost (step 3, 'calling from the landing') although POSTER_EXAMINED is a step 0 optional event with no stated location. This adds an outpost detail. Retag the lines to step 0, remove the landing staging, and make the lines location-neutral, or have the creator decide where the poster is.
JEFF_S3_O2 ('The burner's in there somewhere') and JEFF_S3_O3 ('Go inside the outpost') invent an outpost interior. Reword to non-spatial guidance such as 'Find the burner and bring it to the boat'.
JEFF_S3_12: 'Don't read it, carry it' is unclear about what to carry. Clarify so the player always knows what to do.
TED_S3_01 and TED_S3_02 are staged 'Ted at the dock, lantern swinging', but BURNER_BRIEFING happens in the hall. Align the staging with the hall.
Continuity risk: JEFF_S3_12 and JEFF_S3_13 are triggered by POSTER_EXAMINED, an optional step 0 event. If the poster is examined before step 3, Jeff is not at the outpost.
notes: Creator approves voice and lore before recording (AI Agent Strategy, Dialogue agent).

DANIEL.name: Daniel
DANIEL.role: Young sailor, shelters in the basement

steps.title: Feed the boiler
steps.location: Basement engine room, then the lantern room
steps.player_action: Shovel coal into the boiler firebox until the gauge reaches working pressure and the dynamo whines and the beacon flickers. Then climb to the lantern room and inspect the arc lamp to find the burner broken.

steps.title: Let the sailors in
steps.location: Lighthouse window, dock and island gate, then the hall and basement
steps.player_action: Notice the moored rowboat, go to the island gate and open it for the stranded sailors Jeff and Daniel. Daniel goes down to the basement and stays there.

steps.title: Fetch the replacement burner
steps.location: Hall, dock and launch, the Gullwater crossing, and the abandoned outpost
steps.player_action: Talk with Ted and Jeff in the hall, board the launch at the dock, steer the powered engine boat across the Gullwater with Jeff guiding, dock at the abandoned outpost and pick up the replacement burner.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Eclipse, storm season, and the Saltgate howling. Of course they send a new money toff.
lines.subtitle: TED: Eclipse, storm season, and the Saltgate howling. Of course they send a new money toff.
lines.delivery: Gruff, weary, dry. Ends on a cough.
lines.staging: Ted at the lighthouse entrance, wind audible outside.
lines.note: Introduces eclipse, storm season and the Saltgate.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Beacon's starved. Basement, engine room. Shovel coal into the boiler, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Beacon's starved. Basement, engine room. Shovel coal into the boiler, the new guy.
lines.assist_text: Go to the basement engine room and shovel coal into the boiler firebox until the gauge climbs.
lines.staging: Ted points toward the basement stairs.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Boiler's cold and the beacon's starving. Down to the engine room. Shovel coal, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Boiler's cold and the beacon's starving. Down to the engine room. Shovel coal, the new guy.
lines.assist_text: Go to the basement engine room and shovel coal into the boiler firebox until the gauge climbs.
lines.staging: Ted points toward the basement stairs.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: That's the firebox. Feed it coal, mind your sleeves, and don't stand gawping.
lines.subtitle: TED: That's the firebox. Feed it coal, mind your sleeves, and don't stand gawping.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: There she goes. Keep shovelling; the needle won't climb on good intentions.
lines.subtitle: TED: There she goes. Keep shovelling; the needle won't climb on good intentions.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Good. Again. A fire's a hungry thing, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Good. Again. A fire's a hungry thing, the new guy.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Needle's stirring. Don't stop now, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Needle's stirring. Don't stop now, the new guy.
lines.delivery: Shouted, encouraging in a grumbling way.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Gauge is waking up. Put your back into it.
lines.subtitle: TED: Gauge is waking up. Put your back into it.

lines.beat: Boiler fed, go to lantern room
lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Hear that dynamo whine? Good. Now up to the lantern room and look over the arc lamp.
lines.subtitle: TED: Hear that dynamo whine? Good. Now up to the lantern room and look over the arc lamp.
lines.delivery: Gruff, a rare note of satisfaction.
lines.assist_text: Climb to the lantern room and inspect the arc lamp.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Arc lamp's in the middle. Open her up and look at the burner.
lines.subtitle: TED: Arc lamp's in the middle. Open her up and look at the burner.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Cracked clean through. The burner's finished. Hrmph. Nothing to mend up here.
lines.subtitle: TED: Cracked clean through. The burner's finished. Hrmph. Nothing to mend up here.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Standing there won't warm the boiler. Think where the heat comes from, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Standing there won't warm the boiler. Think where the heat comes from, the new guy.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Basement, the new guy. The engine room. Coal's piled by the firebox.
lines.subtitle: TED: Basement, the new guy. The engine room. Coal's piled by the firebox.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Go down to the engine room. Take the shovel. Load coal into the firebox.
lines.subtitle: TED: Go down to the engine room. Take the shovel. Load coal into the firebox.
lines.assist_text: Go to the basement engine room, take the shovel and load coal into the firebox until the gauge climbs.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Rowboat's moored at my dock. Stranded sailors, by the look. Go let them in at the island gate.
lines.subtitle: TED: Rowboat's moored at my dock. Stranded sailors, by the look. Go let them in at the island gate.
lines.assist_text: Go to the island gate by the dock and open it for the stranded sailors.
lines.staging: Ted at the window, wind rattling the glass.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Someone's tied up at my dock. Down to the island gate, the new guy. Open it for them.
lines.subtitle: TED: Someone's tied up at my dock. Down to the island gate, the new guy. Open it for them.
lines.assist_text: Go to the island gate by the dock and open it for the stranded sailors.
lines.staging: Ted at the window, wind rattling the glass.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: See them? Soaked and stranded. The gate's down the path from the dock. Go on.
lines.subtitle: TED: See them? Soaked and stranded. The gate's down the path from the dock. Go on.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Hoy, up there! Open the gate, would you? We're soaked to the bone.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Hoy, up there! Open the gate, would you? We're soaked to the bone.
lines.delivery: Shouting over wind, friendly but wary.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Easy now, we mean no harm. Just cold and wet. The gate, please?
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Easy now, we mean no harm. Just cold and wet. The gate, please?

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Bless you, the new guy. Daniel, in you come, before the wind changes its mind.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Bless you, the new guy. Daniel, in you come, before the wind changes its mind.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Good hands on that gate. Daniel, move. Quick, now.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Good hands on that gate. Daniel, move. Quick, now.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Ted, you old rock. Thought you'd be drowned by now.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Ted, you old rock. Thought you'd be drowned by now.
lines.note: Proposal: Ted and Jeff relationship is TBD in lore.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Thought the same of you. Hrmph. Dry yourselves. The boy can warm up downstairs.
lines.subtitle: TED: Thought the same of you. Hrmph. Dry yourselves. The boy can warm up downstairs.
lines.delivery: Gruff, a cough hiding a smile.
lines.note: Proposal pairing with JEFF_S2_05. 'The boy' means Daniel.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Oh, a boiler! Lovely. I'll just stay down here, where it's warm. And walled.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Oh, a boiler! Lovely. I'll just stay down here, where it's warm. And walled.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Down here suits me fine. Did the walls just... never mind. Warm is good.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Down here suits me fine. Did the walls just... never mind. Warm is good.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Oh, hello, the new guy! Don't mind me. I'm not going anywhere. Ever.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Oh, hello, the new guy! Don't mind me. I'm not going anywhere. Ever.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Jeff says it's just weather. I'm sure Jeff's right. He's usually right. Mostly.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Jeff says it's just weather. I'm sure Jeff's right. He's usually right. Mostly.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: That wasn't me! Pipes. Has to be the pipes. Old building, lots of pipes.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: That wasn't me! Pipes. Has to be the pipes. Old building, lots of pipes.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Did you hear that? Tell me you heard that. Pipes, right? Say pipes.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Did you hear that? Tell me you heard that. Pipes, right? Say pipes.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: The wall's muttering again. It's the draught. Just the draught, in the stones.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: The wall's muttering again. It's the draught. Just the draught, in the stones.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Don't listen to it. Wind makes all sorts of voices. Hum something. I'm humming.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Don't listen to it. Wind makes all sorts of voices. Hum something. I'm humming.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Those sailors won't dry themselves on my dock, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Those sailors won't dry themselves on my dock, the new guy.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: The gate, the new guy. Down the path from the dock. Someone's shouting out there.
lines.subtitle: TED: The gate, the new guy. Down the path from the dock. Someone's shouting out there.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Walk to the island gate and open it. Let them in.
lines.subtitle: TED: Walk to the island gate and open it. Let them in.
lines.assist_text: Walk to the island gate near the dock and open it to let the sailors in.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Spare burner's at the outpost across the Gullwater. Jeff's boat will take you, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Spare burner's at the outpost across the Gullwater. Jeff's boat will take you, the new guy.
lines.assist_text: Board Jeff's engine boat and cross the Gullwater to the outpost to retrieve the replacement burner.
lines.staging: Ted at the dock, lantern swinging.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: No burner, no beacon. Outpost, across the Gullwater. Go with Jeff, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: TED: No burner, no beacon. Outpost, across the Gullwater. Go with Jeff, the new guy.
lines.assist_text: Board Jeff's engine boat and cross the Gullwater to the outpost to retrieve the replacement burner.
lines.staging: Ted at the dock, lantern swinging.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: In you get. One hand on the wheel, eyes on the rocks.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: In you get. One hand on the wheel, eyes on the rocks.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Sit tight, the new guy. She steers easy if you let her.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Sit tight, the new guy. She steers easy if you let her.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Keep her off the rocks, the new guy. Watch the water, not the dark.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Keep her off the rocks, the new guy. Watch the water, not the dark.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Off we go. Slow on the turns. The Gullwater forgives nothing.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Off we go. Slow on the turns. The Gullwater forgives nothing.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Rocks! Ease her over. Easy, easy. Good.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Rocks! Ease her over. Easy, easy. Good.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Too close! Give the rocks some room, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Too close! Give the rocks some room, the new guy.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Hold on! Back her off the rock and steer clear. Gently now.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Hold on! Back her off the rock and steer clear. Gently now.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: That hull's taken worse. Reverse, turn wide, try again.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: That hull's taken worse. Reverse, turn wide, try again.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Lights on the water! A big ship, and she's bearing for the rocks.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Lights on the water! A big ship, and she's bearing for the rocks.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: There! Ship's lights, out in the swell. She can't see the rocks. No beacon.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: There! Ship's lights, out in the swell. She can't see the rocks. No beacon.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: There's the landing. Fetch the burner. I'll keep the engine turning.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: There's the landing. Fetch the burner. I'll keep the engine turning.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Old paper, the new guy. Don't read it, carry it. Burner first.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Old paper, the new guy. Don't read it, carry it. Burner first.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Nothing there for us. Leave it be. The burner, the burner.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Nothing there for us. Leave it be. The burner, the burner.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: That's it? Good. Hold it close. Back across we go.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: That's it? Good. Hold it close. Back across we go.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Ted wants that burner, the new guy. Boat's waiting on you.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Ted wants that burner, the new guy. Boat's waiting on you.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Come on! The outpost, across the Gullwater. Get in the boat.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Come on! The outpost, across the Gullwater. Get in the boat.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Board the boat, take the wheel, steer for the outpost landing. Go!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Board the boat, take the wheel, steer for the outpost landing. Go!
lines.assist_text: Board the engine boat, steer across the Gullwater and land at the outpost to fetch the burner.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Burner won't walk to the boat, the new guy.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Burner won't walk to the boat, the new guy.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Search the outpost! The burner's in there somewhere. Look sharp!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Search the outpost! The burner's in there somewhere. Look sharp!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Go inside the outpost, find the burner, pick it up, bring it back here.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Go inside the outpost, find the burner, pick it up, bring it back here.
lines.assist_text: Go inside the outpost, find the replacement burner, pick it up and return to the boat.

journal.text: Ted says the beacon is starved. Shovel coal into the boiler in the basement engine room until the gauge climbs.
A rowboat is moored at the dock. Open the island gate and let the stranded sailors in.
The burner is cracked. Cross the Gullwater with Jeff, fetch the replacement burner from the outpost, and bring it back.
